analysis_method.cohorts: scheduled arrival windows [start,end); no filtering away rejected requests
analysis_method.histograms: counter differences across full capture, including 3 warmup requests and drain; means only, not per-request GPU time
analysis_method.thresholds: TTFT 0.5 s; client/control lateness 50 ms unchanged; exploratory large gateway monitor delay >300 ms
analysis_method.interventions: one run per arm; not randomized or counterbalanced; no statistical significance or optimal cap established
